slots.name: verdict status
slots.sentence: The jury in a lawsuit by chipmaker Qualcomm (QCOM.O) against chip technology supplier Arm Holdings (O9Ty.F) did not reach a verdict on Friday as to whether Arm breached licensing agreements and intentionally sabotaged some of Qualcomm's dealings with Meta Platforms (META.O).

slots.name: trial duration
slots.sentence: The five-day trial that wrapped up this week was the second in two years between the companies, highlighting the deterioration of their business relationship after SoftBank Group (9984.T) acquired control of Arm in 2016 and Arm shifted from licensing the technology needed to make chips to selling chips of its own.

slots.name: license end year
slots.sentence: At stake is whether Qualcomm, whose license for Arm's computing architecture runs until 2033, can eventually agree to terms for new versions of Arm's architecture.

slots.name: deliberation duration
slots.sentence: After deliberating for about four hours Friday, the jury had not reached a verdict

slots.name: ruling status
slots.sentence: She has not issued her ruling, and Arm has argued the royalty penalty is unenforceable.
